programs.title: Meet China Episode 4
programs.desc: In this episode, we explore the cutting edge of Chinese industry. We visit China’s first offshore spaceport to see rockets launch toward the stars and move to Hangzhou’s E-Fashion Town, where AI turns designs into reality in seconds. We also follow the \"fantastic journey\" of a bag of garbage as it transforms into energy and bricks with the help of industrial intelligence. Finally, we explore the \"emotional economy,\" where young people find solace in trendy toys and historical fragrances.
